##### Project general facts

DG JKIA is a stylish hotel apartment development by Reportage Properties, offering fully furnished and serviced hotel units designed for comfortable modern living. The unit mix includes Standard Studios, King Studios, Standard One Bedroom and King One Bedroom apartments, with thoughtfully planned layouts and attractive views.

Residents can enjoy an impressive range of hotel-style amenities, including a 24-hour concierge and valet parking, guest lounge, restaurant and bar area, retail shopping complex, swimming pool and fitted gym. The project also features a spa with massage, steam and sauna facilities, a courtyard garden, rooftop yoga garden, rooftop restaurant, barbecue area, private gazebos and a children’s play area, creating a well-rounded lifestyle experience.

The apartments are presented as fully furnished and serviced, with elegant contemporary interiors, comfortable lounge and dining areas, fitted kitchens, bathrooms and built-in storage. Large windows and balconies in selected layouts enhance the interiors with natural light and open views, while the clean, modern design gives the residences a refined and welcoming feel.

##### Parking

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nairobi is a vibrant and dynamic city that combines modern urban living with abundant green spaces and a welcoming atmosphere. As Kenya’s capital and a major regional hub, it offers residents a diverse selection of business, shopping, dining, and entertainment opportunities.

The city is known for its excellent variety of parks and outdoor spaces, providing residents with opportunities to enjoy nature and an active lifestyle. Nairobi National Park, along with numerous recreational areas and green neighborhoods, adds a distinctive sense of openness and tranquility to city living.

Nairobi also benefits from a growing infrastructure and a wide range of international schools, healthcare facilities, restaurants, and retail destinations. Its cosmopolitan character, year-round pleasant climate, and strong cultural scene make the city an attractive place for comfortable and connected everyday living.
